LONG FULL OBLONG-OVAL face, medium broad forehead, fairly full broad middle cheeks, gently curved WIDE lower jaw and a BROAD ROUNDED chin, no sharp inward hexagonal cheek taper. Some fine natural cheek/eye wrinkles. Rather CLOSE-spaced ordinary slim horizontal almond eyes, thick but RESTING almost straight eyebrows, medium-height medium-WIDE moderately SHORT straight nose bridge and BROAD blunt rounded tip, medium-width CLOSED mouth with level thin upper lip and gently fuller lower lip. Exact own reference guides full oblong cheek/jaw and close ordinary eyes, remove the hard glare and curved-up mouth. Distinct from Wang Ji broad rectangular squared jaw, Wang Wei hollow hexagonal cheeks/long slender convex nose and Yuan Shao short lower-heavy trapezoid face. LONG FULL OBLONG-OVAL face, medium broad forehead, fairly full broad middle cheeks, gently curved WIDE lower jaw and a BROAD ROUNDED chin, no sharp inward hexagonal cheek taper. Some fine natural cheek/eye wrinkles. Rather CLOSE-spaced ordinary slim horizontal almond eyes, thick but RESTING almost straight eyebrows, medium-height medium-WIDE moderately SHORT straight nose bridge and BROAD blunt rounded tip, medium-width CLOSED mouth with level thin upper lip and gently fuller lower lip. Dark full medium mustache with mostly horizontal natural ends, a LONG NARROW divided dark beard under chin, sparse cheek beard. Exact own reference guides full oblong cheek/jaw and close ordinary eyes, remove the hard glare and curved-up mouth. Distinct from Wang Ji broad rectangular squared jaw, Wang Wei hollow hexagonal cheeks/long slender convex nose and Yuan Shao short lower-heavy trapezoid face. Plain DARK GREY-IRON lamellar over muted TEAL-GREY fitted sleeves, warm KHAKI cross-collar inner shirt, plain brown leather wrist guards/belt, dark trousers and field boots. LONG FULL OBLONG-OVAL face, medium broad forehead, fairly full broad middle cheeks, gently curved WIDE lower jaw and a BROAD ROUNDED chin, no sharp inward hexagonal cheek taper. role.evidence: 名册为魏天水太守王颀。演义条目记随邓艾伐蜀、同牵弘设伏攻绵竹及任益州郡守；史条目记随毌丘俭东方远征、历东方郡守及应邻国请求促成和解。依军事远征与郡守、接洽职责分类统帅兼文务，不由兵种或能力值推断，也不将演义战斗细节宣称为史实。

Use case: identity-preserve
人物：王颀 / person-28
原创汉末三国策略游戏的半写实手绘人物，参考三国志系列人物像的克制、沉稳和自然比例：细墨线、柔和笔触、低饱和青绿与暖赭、自然布帛和铁铜，面容清晰，柔和均衡光线。表情尽量中性，眉眼放松、嘴唇自然闭合，动作幅度小、手部舒适。每张按用途独立设计头像、立绘、半身和横幅取景；场景差异主要通过坐立、道具、视线与构图体现，不为了区分而夸张表演。完整头饰，无文字、水印、边框和拼图，只有一名主体人物。
人物类型：主类型：战场统帅；次类型：文臣学士。依据：名册为魏天水太守王颀。演义条目记随邓艾伐蜀、同牵弘设伏攻绵竹及任益州郡守；史条目记随毌丘俭东方远征、历东方郡守及应邻国请求促成和解。依军事远征与郡守、接洽职责分类统帅兼文务，不由兵种或能力值推断，也不将演义战斗细节宣称为史实。。人物仪态：有远征、地方治理与接洽经验的稳重军职统帅，实用轻甲与贴身军装；部署、营防、军需和训练准备保持军人仪态，外交及奏报自然倾听和口头报告。治理可以核补给与平放单份记录，但不统一执笔捧书；无夸张杀伐或文化刻板饰物。。中性仅限制表情和动作幅度，不能改变人物职业气质；具体个人动作也必须符合该类型。
身份：Original visual age46, ordinary mature military governor build, normal head and shoulders. LONG FULL OBLONG-OVAL face, medium broad forehead, fairly full broad middle cheeks, gently curved WIDE lower jaw and a BROAD ROUNDED chin, no sharp inward hexagonal cheek taper. Some fine natural cheek/eye wrinkles. Rather CLOSE-spaced ordinary slim horizontal almond eyes, thick but RESTING almost straight eyebrows, medium-height medium-WIDE moderately SHORT straight nose bridge and BROAD blunt rounded tip, medium-width CLOSED mouth with level thin upper lip and gently fuller lower lip. Dark full medium mustache with mostly horizontal natural ends, a LONG NARROW divided dark beard under chin, sparse cheek beard. Exact own reference guides full oblong cheek/jaw and close ordinary eyes, remove the hard glare and curved-up mouth. Distinct from Wang Ji broad rectangular squared jaw, Wang Wei hollow hexagonal cheeks/long slender convex nose and Yuan Shao short lower-heavy trapezoid face. ORIGINAL LOW MATTE CHARCOAL-IRON round helmet with simple narrow guards, no plume, gems, tall crest or long chin straps. Plain DARK GREY-IRON lamellar over muted TEAL-GREY fitted sleeves, warm KHAKI cross-collar inner shirt, plain brown leather wrist guards/belt, dark trousers and field boots. No bright blue cape, knotted scarf, jeweled collar or carved shoulder ornaments. EXACTLY ONE sword fully SHEATHED and belt-attached at one hip, never drawn. A closed simple military dispatch wallet only where specified. Practical cultivated commander bearing in military supplies, governance and reception. 长饱满椭圆脸、近眼距、稍短宽直鼻与阔圆颏、长窄分颏须；低炭铁盔、深铁甲、灰青袖。
输入图仅作该人物身份与服饰参考，不锁定原图动作或表情。
固定脸型、年龄、胡须、头饰、体型、主色与标志物，身份参考不锁定皱眉或动作。重新设计自然姿态与取景，只做细微神态差异。禁止怒吼、露齿、大笑、瞪眼、挑眉、鬼脸、抓须扶额、向镜头伸掌、大幅挥击、伸臂指点、扭身、飞扬披风和夸张透视；手臂靠近身体，头肩与五官比例正常。中性与自然优先于表情差异。
画幅：1536×1152，横向半身像，有场景背景。
场景含义：汇报已完成事项，克制满意，嘴唇闭合。简洁汇报部署或战果，允许单份军情记录但不必捧卷。
该人物独立表演（符合人物类型，并优先于通用示例手势）：STANDING near-FRONTAL half-body beside camp-gate reporting table, ONE hand rests LOW flat on table edge, OTHER arm comfortably BEHIND back. Composed CLOSED-mouth oral report, no book or pen, one sheathed sword.

role.evidence: 名册为魏国之臣王业。演义条目记其参与曹髦谋议后同王沈向司马昭通报；史条目只明确后来任晋中护军。按朝廷文务与明确中护军军职作混合美术分类，条目没有亲自冲阵战绩，不凭通报情节造奸相，也不凭兵种或能力推断。
role.bearing: 兼有军务官职的沉稳朝臣，原创低布冠、整齐实用官服与贴身军务外衣，保持在岗协调者仪态。内政核军需、训练准备与营防协调、接洽和口头奏报，部署及战斗为阵后军务观察；无读书拢袖全套模板，也不强加前锋盔甲和持剑挥击。按职务可用印匣与单份平放记录，手势低位自然。
role.propExceptions: 朝廷与军务行政可使用单份平放记录或封闭印匣；演义通报不是持卷奸笑的面容设计依据。

人物：王业 / person-30

身份：Original visual age35, ordinary slender mature military-office official, natural upright unpretentious build. LONG SLENDER RECTANGULAR-OVAL face, fairly TALL slightly broader open forehead, narrow modest cheekbones, gently flat/slightly hollow lower cheeks and a NARROW rounded chin with soft tapering jaw, no broad round pear face or sharply pointed V-face. Some subtle ordinary eye-fold texture. Fairly CLOSE-spaced ordinary long slim almond eyes, FINE gently curved RESTING brows, a LOW FLAT moderately SHORT NARROW straight nose bridge and small COMPACT blunt rounded tip, small medium-width naturally CLOSED mouth with thin upper lip and softly fuller lower lip, no smile/lip asymmetry inherited from reference. COMPLETELY clean-shaven, black short side hair, no goatee or grey strands. Own exact reference guides slender narrow cheek/jaw and close eyes, relax tilted head/sly eyebrows. Distinct from Yan Pu broader long oval/square chin and high longer nose bridge, Yuan Yao shorter broad pear/full cheeks/wide round nose and Yin Shang broader taper/short mustache. ORIGINAL LOW ASH-BLUE-GREY soft rectangular cloth court cap with thin BROWN band, no high green block tower, gem, plume or helmet. Plain muted OLIVE long cross-collar robe with close practical sleeves, simple ASH-GREY short military-office OVERVEST, cream inner collar, CHARCOAL cloth sash and dark cloth shoes. No armor, wrist bracers, sword, feather fan, cape or jewelry. Closed small military seal box or cloth dispatch wallet only in specified scenes. Quiet officer coordinating court/military administration, no sneer, cunning glance or passive folded scholar sleeves. 长窄矩椭圆脸、近眼距、低平稍短细鼻、小圆颏与无须；低灰蓝布冠、橄榄袍、灰短军务外衣。
输入图仅作该人物身份与服饰参考，不锁定原图动作或表情。
固定脸型、年龄、胡须、头饰、体型、主色与标志物，身份参考不锁定皱眉或动作。重新设计自然姿态与取景，只做细微神态差异。禁止怒吼、露齿、大笑、瞪眼、挑眉、鬼脸、抓须扶额、向镜头伸掌、大幅挥击、伸臂指点、扭身、飞扬披风和夸张透视；手臂靠近身体，头肩与五官比例正常。中性与自然优先于表情差异。
